clue.text: Comic-strip character pops back uncooked cabbage

clue.text: Young socialite with heart — ultimately, that's a liability

explanation.definitionFit: A dalliance is a casual romance or flirtation, not taken seriously.

clue.text: Yes, Virginia, there is a greeting inside school

clue.text: A Schubert composition for a European city

clue.text: Hunter fit poorly in capital

clue.text: Frustrated Italians surround university — Germans destroyed it

the Roman numeral D

clue.text: Two rebels, Southern parasites
